# SPX Construction

> Wasatch Front design·build firm for considered residential work — new custom
> residences, whole-home renovations, additions & second stories, daylight lower
> levels & walkouts, and structural site work — one team from first sketch to
> final walk-through.

## About

SPX is a design·build studio and licensed residential general contractor within
a Utah construction family with two decades of work on the Wasatch Front — a
Spravek company, alongside Alpine Fence & Deck and Harlow Landscapes. Design,
engineering, budget, and build live under one roof: the people who design and
price the work are the people who build it. Concrete, framing, and finish
carpentry are self-performed; licensed trade partners run mechanical,
electrical, and plumbing under SPX supervision. The studio takes on a
deliberate number of projects at a time, each with a principal's attention.

- Region: Utah — Wasatch Front
- Cities served: Salt Lake City, Lehi, Sandy, Draper, Alpine, Highland,
  Pleasant Grove, Provo, Holladay, Cottonwood Heights, Bountiful, Farmington,
  Park City, Heber City, Saratoga Springs
- Counties served: Salt Lake, Utah, Summit, Davis, Wasatch
- Price tier: high-end residential ($$$$)

## Capabilities

- Design·build delivery — design, stamped engineering, budget, permits, and construction under one contract
- New custom residences — ground-up homes, site to keys
- Whole-home renovations — structural reconfigurations, kitchens, primary suites, systems
- Additions & second stories — matched rooflines, engineered tie-ins
- Lower levels & walkouts — theaters, wine rooms, guest suites, engineered walkout entrances, egress, ADU entrances
- Garages, structures & site — accessory buildings, structural concrete, steel, retaining

## Frequently asked

### Where does SPX work?
Across Utah's Wasatch Front — Salt Lake, Utah, Summit, Davis, and Wasatch
counties, including Salt Lake City, Holladay, Draper, and Park City.

### What does design·build mean at SPX?
One team and one contract from first sketch to final walk-through. Design
development happens with the builders in the room, so every detail is drawn
once, priced honestly, and built as drawn.

### Do you handle permits and engineering?
Yes. Every structural scope carries stamped engineering, and every project is
permitted and inspected. SPX manages the full package and delivers the
documentation at close-out.

### Can you cut a walkout or separate entrance into an existing foundation?
Yes — it is a quiet specialty. Foundation cut, shoring, excavation, retaining,
drainage, stairwell, and door system, engineered and permitted, including
separate entrances for suites and ADUs where zoning allows.

### Are you part of a larger company?
Yes. SPX is part of the Alpine Fence & Deck family of companies — a Spravek
company — twenty years of construction craft on the Wasatch Front, under one
accountability line.
